summary.text: Jennifer Miles is the Republican candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 29B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Nate Roberts.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the owner of two small businesses and a former clinical director in substance abuse and mental health treatment.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer Miles graduated from Soda Springs High School and earned bachelor's degrees from Idaho State University in 2005 and 2010, according to Ballotpedia.
In her survey responses, she said her degrees were in political science and social work, and that she completed a master's degree in social work at Boise State University in 2012.
She said she spent eight years as a clinical director for a treatment agency in Pocatello.
Miles named education, small business and economic growth, public safety and keeping public lands public as her policy priorities in the survey.
